title: Urgent Hiring – Full Stack AI Python Developer
description:
Urgent Hiring – Full Stack AI Python Developer
Location: DHA Phase 8, Lahore, Pakistan
Job Type: Full-Time (Onsite)
Timings: 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM
Job Description
We are urgently hiring a talented Full Stack AI Python Developer with strong hands-on experience in Python development and AI/ML technologies. The ideal candidate should be passionate about building intelligent systems, writing clean code, and working in a fast-paced development environment.
This role is primarily development-focused, with opportunities to work on cutting-edge AI solutions and modern full-stack applications.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models using Python
Build and maintain backend systems and APIs (Django / Flask / FastAPI)
Integrate AI features into web and mobile applications
Work with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face
Collaborate with frontend and mobile developers (React, Flutter, etc.)
Optimize application performance and scalability
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
Requirements
Strong experience in Python development
Hands-on experience in AI/ML (NLP, Deep Learning, ML pipelines)
Experience with Django / Flask / FastAPI
Knowledge of API development and integration
Good English communication skills
Ability to work onsite in DHA Phase 8, Lahore
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Nice to Have
Experience with LLMs (OpenAI APIs, LangChain, RAG pipelines)
Knowledge of Docker, CI/CD, AWS/Azure/GCP
Exposure to React, Laravel, or Flutter
Experience working on SaaS, ERP, or Healthcare projects
Only serious and immediate joiners are encouraged to apply.
Job Type: Full-time
Pay: Rs120,000.00 - Rs135,000.00 per month
Work Location: In person
